mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured by the 1-month change in FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sub-4.0% unemployment rate signals an overheating labor market that increases the probability of imminent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and GDPC1 show positive month-over-month growth.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (as indicated by rising FEDFUNDS), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO falls below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals increasing inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly retail sales figure (RSAFS) above 530,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS exceeds 530,000 million dollars.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial contraction (INDPRO below 108.0), the S&P 500 tends to decline due to weak manufacturing activity and recession fears, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO is below 108.0.
